note: Govt monthly/weekly releases. Main figures sources se verified; headlines roz auto-update (Google News). Indicative only - not advice.

ind.name: GST Collections
ind.sub: gross · Aug 2026 · net ₹1.68 lakh cr · record ₹2.43 (Apr-26) vs ₹1.87 (Apr-23) = +30% 3 saal me
ind.why: High GST = desh me consumption strong. Consumption zyada to company sales aur profit badhta hai.
ind.impact: Bullish: FMCG (HUL, ITC), auto, retail; banks bhi

ind.name: Railway Freight
ind.sub: loading · Aug 2026 · iron ore +12.1%, coal +6%, containers +9.2%
ind.why: Coal, steel, cement freight badhna = industrial activity real-time pulse. GDP leading indicator.
ind.impact: Bullish: NTPC, Coal India, Tata Steel, JSW, cement stocks

ind.name: Port Traffic
ind.sub: Aug 2026 · JNPT record 8.32 lakh TEU (+19.5%) · Mundra record 18.6 MT · APSEZ 50 MMT (+19%)
ind.why: Import-export ka proxy. Container traffic badhna = trade strong. Export companies ka leading indicator.
ind.impact: Bullish: Adani Ports, Concor; exporters ko dekho

ind.name: Auto Sales (SIAM/FADA)
ind.sub: retail · Aug 2026 · Maruti domestic +34.8%, Tata PV +59% · CNG+hybrid+EV ab 42% share (petrol se zyada pehli baar)
ind.why: Monthly sales numbers results se pehle mil jaate hain - stock move karne se pehle trend pakdo.
ind.impact: Bullish: Maruti, Tata Motors, M&M; Bajaj/TVS 2W bhi

ind.name: EPFO Jobs
ind.sub: wage ceiling ₹15k → ₹25k · 16 Sep 2026 · 7.98 cr members total
ind.why: Formal jobs badhna = employment health. RBI bhi ye data dekhta hai. Consumption ka long-term signal.

ind.name: Power Demand
ind.sub: peak · 10 Sep 2026 · highest-ever Sep · 5-saal: 2021 ~200 GW → ab 270 GW (+35%) · May-24 250 → May-26 270
ind.why: Power consumption = industrial activity + GDP growth ka proxy. Sep 1-9 consumption +20.7% YoY.
ind.impact: Bullish: NTPC, Power Grid, Tata Power, coal stocks

ind.name: GDP Growth
ind.why: Desh ki total kamai. GDP badhe to company earnings badhti hain - sab stocks ka pita-mata. World me sabse tez bade economy me se ek.

ind.name: Inflation (CPI)
ind.sub: Aug 2026 · food 5.95% · 3 mahine se badha (May 3.93 → Aug 4.82) · rate hike ka risk
ind.why: Mehngai badhna = RBI rate hike ka darr = loans mehnge = market ko pasand nahi. Kam inflation = rate cut ka hope = bull run ka fuel.
ind.impact: Careful: banks, realty, auto (loans wale); FMCG defensive better

ind.name: PMI (Factory+Services)
ind.sub: Sep flash · Mfg 55.7 (7-mahine high) · Services 55.8 · Composite 56.5 (Aug: 54.3) · 50 ke upar = expansion
ind.why: Factories + services ko survey: order, production, hiring. GDP se 1 mahina PEHLE aata hai - leading indicator. 55+ = strong expansion, 48 se neeche = tension.
ind.impact: Bullish: manufacturing (L&T, Siemens, ABB), banks; mfg output sub-index 58.2 = bahut strong

ind.name: 8-Core Sector Growth
ind.sub: Aug 2026 (3rd month me sabse slow) · Cement +12.5%, Bijli +11.6%, Iron ore +5.5% · Koyla -3.8%, Fertilizer -12.4% · Apr-Aug: +4.3% vs 2.4% pichhle saal · FY26: 3.0% vs FY25: 4.3%
ind.why: 8 bade industrial sectors (IIP ka 40%) - coal, steel, cement, bijli, refinery, crude, gas, fertilizer. Infra/construction activity ka asli pulse.
ind.impact: Bullish: UltraTech, Shree Cement, Tata Steel, power stocks; fertilizer cos (Coromandel, Chambal) pe pressure

ind.name: FII Flows (Monthly)
ind.sub: Sep (till 18) · Jul +20,200 · Aug +29,631 · 2026 total: -₹2.45 lakh cr (2025: -1.66 L) · Wajah: Brent $100+, US rates 3.75-4%, rupee record-low 96 · DII buying se girawao ruka
ind.why: Videshi paisa - sabse direct market-moving number. FII buying month = fuel, selling month = pressure. Sep me DII +36,219 cr ne FII selling absorb ki.
ind.impact: FII selling = market pressure, specially large-caps; DII cushion. Turnaround tab jab crude thanda ho / US rates ruke

ind.name: UPI Digital Payments
ind.sub: Aug 2026 · record 24.51 arab transactions (+22% YoY) · value +20% YoY · 10 saal: FY17 ₹0.07 → FY26 ₹314 lakh cr = 4,000x · digital payments ka 84%
ind.why: Digital payment = consumption ka daily pulse. UPI badhna = kirana se lekar premium tak spending strong.
ind.impact: Bullish: Paytm, fintech, banks (HDFC, Axis, ICICI); NPCI ecosystem

ind.name: IIP Factory Output
ind.sub: Jul 2026 · Mfg +7.3%, Bijli +8.7%, Mining +0.9% · trend: Apr 4.1 → May 4.9 → Jun 5.1 → Jul 6.7 (tez ho raha) · bank credit to industry +20%
ind.why: Factories ki asli production (PMI opinion hai, IIP asli number). Core sector + IIP = industry ka pura picture.
ind.impact: Bullish: capital goods (L&T, ABB, Siemens), manufacturing, banks

ind.name: Forex Reserves
ind.sub: record · 4 Sep 2026 · ek hafte me +$44.9 B (sabse bada jump ever) · 10 hafte lagaataar upar · world me 4th (Russia se aage) · FCNR swap scheme se $136 B aaya
ind.why: RBI ki rupee bachane ki taakat. Zyada reserve = rupee strong = FII confidence. (Note: FCNR paisa udhaar hai, 2029 me wapas dena padega.)
ind.impact: Stability signal; rupee girne pe RBI intervene kar sakta hai

ind.name: Trade (Exports)
ind.sub: Aug 2026 exports +26.1% YoY (50-month high) · imports $70.7 B (+14.1%) · deficit $26.9 B = 5-month low (gold imports aadhe girre) · goods+services gap sirf $9.4 B · risk: crude Sep $110/bbl
ind.why: Exports badhna = desh ki kamai + kam forex nikalna. Services surplus ($17.5 B) bada cushion hai. Crude mehnga = deficit ka sabse bada risk.
ind.impact: Bullish: IT, pharma, auto ancillary exports (US +21.8%); OMC/aviation pe crude cost pressure
